relations.description: Neutral glucose must not exceed the water blank as though fully ionic.
Waiting must not invent material in plain water.
Waiting must not create a filterable carbon-bearing phase.
An unsupported combustion path must not consume potassium chloride.
Waiting without a process must preserve sealed-gas pressure.
Filtering plain water must conserve hydrogen and oxygen across vessels.
Waiting alone must not alter neutral-solute pH.
